recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed unless a future workflow-pattern decision intentionally renames or removes Event.partOf or Definition.partOf.
issue_request: FHIR-12159 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request for the FHIR-I workflow patterns, asking to rename the Event and Definition pattern element "parent" to "partOf" because "part of" was more meaningful.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit da1b7bca49bd309d1ef3ca64e071f3a61056b71c, corresponding to SVN @10157, which changed the authoritative Event and Definition pattern spreadsheets from Event.parent/Definition.parent to Event.partOf/Definition.partOf.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini still lists definition and event as active logical models. The current spreadsheets contain Event.partOf and Definition.partOf rows and part-of search mappings, and exact searches found no Event.parent or Definition.parent remnants in the target pattern sources. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later decision reversing the rename.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already implements the final Jira decision.
